# rixl_post (Resource)

Publishes and manages a media post within a Rixl content feed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_post" "announcement" {
  project_id  = var.rixl_project_id
  feed_id     = rixl_feed.main.id
  video_id    = rixl_video.keynote.id
  description = "Watch the replay of our platform announcement."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feed_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `creator_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `image_id` (String)
- `org_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `video_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
